fusions.name: Head-On Clash
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then a blow that deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A hurled blow on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at the end of its reach, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Not Today
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You restore 12 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Second Stomach
fusions.desc: Each time a condition on you wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
